Alex —

Appreciate the detail — good questions. Short answers and clarification: 

- Migration path: yes — our API abstraction and model pinning allow you to start on Hosted and move to Dedicated/private with minimal prompt changes. Main work is around network egress (VPC peering / VPN) and secrets/KMS configuration.
- Burst/fallbacks: Dedicated has configurable burst capacity and automated fallback to lower-cost compatible model variants in other regions/tiered pools. We also support throttling policies and queueing to protect latency SLOs.
- Audit & KMS: Private provides customer-managed KMS and full audit log export. Hosted offers encrypted-at-rest with BYOK for Enterprise plans.

I've added Dev to coordinate the technical checklist and Rachel to help with procurement and security artifacts.

Alex / team —

Quick technical notes ahead of Wednesday's session so we can use the time efficiently. Below is a migration checklist and info we typically collect: 

1) Current infra & traffic patterns- Peak qps, avg token length, batch jobs schedule, peak windows
2) Model compatibility- Model family used today, supported quantization, KV cache needs (session length, reuse patterns)
3) Data flow & residency- Which requests contain customer PII, where logs must live, retention windows
4) Network & security- VPN/VPC peering options, firewall egress rules (IPs/Ports), proxy requirements
5) Secrets & keys- KMS provider, rotation policy, HSM requirements
6) Migration strategy options- a) Dual-write (both APIs) for gradual cutover, b) Shadow traffic to measure parity, c) Bulk reprocessing on Dedicated / on-prem for backfills
7) Hardware constraints- Minimum GPU profile for Dedicated (we recommend A10/A100 class for production), expected queuing tolerances
8) Observability- Token-level tracing, per-route latency breakdowns, error budgets

If you can drop answers into the attached mutual action plan before the call it will help. For the Hosted-to-Private path we typically estimate a 2-4 week timeline for networking + KMS + SSO integration (depends on your infra lead availability).

Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
